object: EQUIVALENCE BETWEEN A UNIVERSAL POLYNOMIAL EXACT CARRIER FOR THE AUTHORITATIVE E6 SIGNED-HUANG CONNECTED SOURCE CLASS AND P=NP

carrier_contract.input: an authoritative E6 source state encoding arbitrary finite signed 3-CNF
must_support: polynomial-time reconstruction of a coloring witness

directions.name: CARRIER_IMPLIES_P_EQUALS_NP
directions.proof_target: Use exact 3-CNF embedding; base feasibility decides arbitrary 3-SAT in polynomial time.

directions.name: P_EQUALS_NP_IMPLIES_CARRIER
proof_target: If P=NP then 3-SAT decision is polynomial.
By standard self-reduction, a satisfying Boolean assignment is reconstructible with polynomially many SAT-decision calls.
Store the E6 factor instance itself as a polynomial-size carrier.
Translate base/R1/R2/update restrictions to polynomial-size signed 3-CNF constraints on equality bits plus constant local factor data.
Solve with the assumed polynomial SAT procedure and reconstruct equality bits, pair states, local C7 witnesses, fixed seed/X0 colors, and independent receipts.

firewalls: This is an equivalence theorem, not a proof of either P=NP or P!=NP.
No hidden polynomial SAT solver may be assumed except conditionally in the P=NP=>carrier direction.
No recursive general R1/R2 authorization follows unconditionally.
